app.name: TDC
app.tagline: Where the community talks, plans, and finds each other.

auth.tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts. Try again later.
auth.endingSessionSignsOut: Ending a session signs that device out immediately.
auth.addressConfirmedDetail: If you ever forget your password, you can set a new one through it.
auth.communityDescription: Channels and threads for discussion, projects to track the work, and a directory connecting developers with the people who need them. Run on your own server, by the community, for the community.
auth.confirmationLinkExpiredDetail: Links work once and last a day, and asking for a new one replaces the old. You can ask again from your settings.
auth.freeAndOpenSource: Free and open source. Self-hosted, always.
auth.passwordChangedDetail: Every device that was signed in has been signed out. Sign in with the new password.
auth.recoveryLinkExpiredDetail: It has been used already, or the hour it lasts has passed. Asking again will send a fresh one.
auth.setNewPasswordDetail: Choose something you will keep. There is no password reset beyond this one.
auth.setUpThisServerDetail: This account becomes the server's administrator. It can only be created once.
auth.usernameBecomesAddress: Your username becomes your address on this server.
auth.twoStepHint: A code from an app on your phone, as well as your password. Somebody who learns your password still cannot sign in.
auth.twoStepRequired: This server requires two-step sign-in on your account. Set it up to carry on.
auth.recoveryCodesHint: Each works once, for the day you cannot reach your app. Write them down or keep them somewhere safe — this is the only time they are shown.
auth.addToAuthenticator: Add this to your authenticator app
auth.addToAuthenticatorHint: Scan the code in your app, or type the key below if you cannot scan.
auth.passkeyAlreadyCovers: Your passkey already covers this — signing in with your password asks for it as the second step. An authenticator app is an alternative, not a requirement.
auth.turnOffPasswordHint: Your password, to confirm this is you. Turning this off also removes your recovery codes.
auth.recoveryLinkOnWay: If there is an account with that address, a link to set a new password is on its way. It works once, and for an hour.
auth.recoveryNothingArrived: Nothing arrived? Check the address you typed, and the spam folder. If the account has no confirmed email address, an administrator is the only way back in.
auth.forgottenPasswordHint: Give the email address on your account and we will send a link to set a new password.
auth.oauthExpired: That sign-in took too long. Try again.
auth.oauthAlreadyAttached: That account is already connected to a different account here.
auth.oauthFailed: The provider could not complete the sign-in. Try again.
auth.connectToAccountHint: An account here already uses that email address. Sign in to it once and this provider will work on its own from then on.
auth.chooseUsernameHint: This is how people will see you here. It does not have to match the one you use elsewhere.
auth.enterYourCodeHint: From your authenticator app. If you cannot reach it, one of your recovery codes works here too.
auth.emailedCodeOnWay: A code is on its way to the address on your account. Enter it above — it works once, for five minutes.
auth.sendCodeToEmail: Send a code to my email instead
auth.recoveryCodesLeftSingular: You have {count} recovery code left. Make more from your settings once you are in.
auth.recoveryCodesLeftPlural: You have {count} recovery codes left. Make more from your settings once you are in.
auth.passkeysHint: Sign in with your fingerprint, face or device PIN instead of a password. The key stays on your device.
auth.noPasskeysYet: You have none yet. Adding one takes a moment and means you can sign in without typing anything.

nav.searchHint: Find a channel, somebody to talk to, or something that was said.
nav.searchFailed: The search could not be completed. Try again.
nav.pickConversation: Pick a conversation from the sidebar to carry on where you left off.
nav.joinToStart: Join a channel from the sidebar, or create one to get started.
nav.serverUnreachable: This server is not reachable right now. Its rooms will appear again when it returns.
nav.noPublishedRooms: This server publishes no rooms you can browse.

room.hostedElsewhereHint: This room is hosted on {server}. If that server is unavailable, the room is too.
room.showingAsItWas: Showing this conversation as it was {when}
room.offlineWillLoad: You are offline. This conversation will load when the connection comes back.
room.noRepliesYet: No replies yet. Start the discussion.
room.scheduledForLater: Scheduled. It will send at the time you chose.
room.reportedToModerator: Reported. A moderator will look at it.
room.actionFailed: That could not be answered. Try again.

channel.name: Name
channel.noPermission: You do not have permission to create channels on this server.

lifetime.afterSendingHint: It goes when the time is up, whether or not anybody read it.
lifetime.onceSeenHint: It goes as soon as the last person opens the conversation.
lifetime.afterSeeing: A set time after each person reads it
lifetime.afterSeeingHint: Everybody gets the same window, however long they took to look.
lifetime.title: When this message expires
lifetime.visibleToAll: Everybody in the conversation can see that this message will expire. A lifetime can be made shorter afterwards, never longer.

channel.slugRule: Letters, digits, underscore, dot and hyphen.
channel.nameBecomesAddress: The name becomes the channel's address, so people on other servers can reach it.
channel.disposableHint: Messages are removed after a set time. Everyone in the chat is told before they post.

attachment.failed: That file could not be sent.
attachment.gifsUnreachable: The GIF library could not be reached.

notification.title: Notifications
notification.whileClosed: Told about a message while TDC is closed. Each device is separate.
notification.keepOffLockScreen: Keep messages off my lock screen
notification.keepOffLockScreenHint: A notification says something arrived, not what it said.
notification.blockedInBrowser: Notifications are blocked for this site in your browser's settings.
notification.notSetUp: This server has not set up notifications.
notification.browserCannot: This browser could not register for notifications. Its push service is unavailable, which is a limit of the browser rather than of this server — TDC still notifies you while it is open.
notification.staleKey: This device is subscribed with a key this server no longer uses. Removing it below and subscribing again will fix it.
notification.couldNotSubscribe: This device could not be subscribed.
notification.couldNotRemove: That device could not be removed.

settings.title: Settings
settings.statusHint: What others see beside your name. Your server's administrator chooses which are available.
settings.appearanceHint: Following your device is the default, and changes with it.
settings.languageHint: What this application speaks to you in.
settings.gettingAroundHint: The short introduction to the application, if you would like it again.
settings.privacyHint: Who may start a conversation with you. Existing conversations are unaffected by narrowing this.
settings.anyoneHint: Anybody on this server can start a conversation with you.
settings.sharedChannel: People I share a channel with
settings.sharedChannelHint: Colleagues can reach you; people you have never met cannot.
settings.nobodyHint: No new conversations. Moderators can still reach you, so that nobody is beyond contact by the people responsible for this server.
settings.blockedHint: People you have blocked cannot start a conversation with you. They are not told, and this list is yours alone.
settings.accentHint: The colour on buttons and links. Adjusted for light and dark so its label stays readable in both. Leave it empty for the one this palette comes with.
settings.coloursHint: Each works in both light and dark.
settings.endSessionDetail: {device} will be signed out straight away, in the middle of whatever it is doing. Whoever is using it is not told why, and will have to sign in again.
settings.moderatorCanSeeDisclosure: A moderator reviewing a report can see what you have turned off, and every time they do it is written to the audit log.
settings.showsLastSeenHint: A record of when you work and when you stop, if it is shown.
settings.showsPresenceHint: Turning this off does not disconnect you or change what you receive.
settings.showsStatusHint: The status you have chosen and the note that goes with it.
settings.unblockDetail: They will be able to start a conversation with you again. They are not told that they were blocked, or that they no longer are.
settings.whatOthersCanSee: What others can see about you
settings.whatOthersCanSeeHint: Your name and address are always shown. Anything you turn off here is left out of what the server sends, not hidden afterwards.

update.typedIsKept: What you have typed is kept.

conversations.title: Your conversations
conversations.body: Channels you have joined, and the people you are talking to. Whatever you were last reading is where you come back to.

finding.title: Finding something
finding.body: Search messages, channels and people from here — or press the shortcut shown, from anywhere.

starting.title: Starting a channel
starting.body: A channel is a room for a subject. Anyone on this server can be in one, unless you make it private.

missed.title: What you have missed
missed.body: Unread messages gather here. You decide per channel how much you want to hear, in its settings.

error.generic: The server could not complete the request.
error.forbidden: You do not have permission to do that.
error.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Try again later.

moderation.allDealtWith: Every report has been dealt with.
moderation.banAppliesToChannelOnlyHint: A ban applies to this channel only. Everything else they belong to is untouched.
moderation.banConsequenceHint: They will be removed from this channel and cannot rejoin it. Everything else they belong to is untouched.
moderation.cannotReadQueue: You cannot read the moderation queue.
moderation.cannotSeeWhoIsBanned: You do not have permission to see who is banned here.
moderation.keptOnRecordHint: Kept on the record as considered and not acted on.
moderation.liftBanConsequence: {username} will be able to rejoin this channel and post in it again.
moderation.nextModeratorWillReadHint: The next moderator to see this person reported will read this.
moderation.nobodyBannedFromThisChannel: Nobody is banned from this channel.
moderation.notAnonymousHint: A moderator will see this message and what you have written. Reporting is not anonymous to them.
moderation.reportedOldestFirstHint: What people have reported, oldest first. The person reported is never told who reported them.
moderation.reportingUnavailable: Reporting is unavailable at the moment.

admin.anyServerExceptThoseListed: Any server except those listed below
admin.anyServerThatProvesWhoItIs: Any server that proves who it is
admin.auditLogHint: Every security- and administration-relevant action, most recent first. Reading this log is itself recorded.
admin.cannotManagePeople: You cannot manage people on this server.
admin.capabilityNotChanged: That capability could not be changed.
admin.capabilityOffHint: A capability turned off here is refused by the server and is not advertised to clients, so the control disappears rather than failing.
admin.couldNotLoadAuditLog: Could not load the audit log.
admin.deliverAndShowModerator: Deliver it, and show a moderator
admin.deliverWithWordsReplaced: Deliver it with the words replaced
admin.invitationLinkAndCode: A link, and a short code for reading aloud. Both last a week.
admin.notConfiguredYetHint: Nothing is configured for this yet, so it stays unavailable.
admin.readOnlyConfigurationHint: Read-only. These come from the environment or the configuration file and need a restart to change. The source says whether a value was chosen or merely inherited.
admin.recordedShownToReviewerHint: Recorded, and shown to whoever reviews this later.
admin.sayWhyHint: Say why, for whoever reviews this.
admin.shareNowNotShownAgain: Share this now — it is not shown again.
admin.suspendConsequenceHint: Their sessions end at once and they cannot sign in. What they have written stays where it is.
admin.suspendingEndsSessionsHint: Suspending somebody ends their sessions and stops them signing in. Their messages stay.
admin.suspensionNotLifted: That suspension could not be lifted.
admin.withdrawConsequenceHint: The link stops working immediately. Anybody holding it will not be able to join, and will not be told why.

directory.title: Directory
directory.intro: People on this server who chose to be found, and the companies they agreed to be listed by. Nobody appears here without deciding to.

visibility.publicHint: Anyone who can browse this server's directory, including people not signed in.
visibility.membersHint: People signed in to this server.

form.notAnEmail: That is not an email address.
form.notAWebLink: Use a web link starting with http:// or https://.

profile.title: Your directory profile
profile.whoCanFindYouHint: Whether your profile appears in the directory at all. Nothing in it is ever more visible than this.
profile.aboutYouHint: All optional. Say as much or as little as you like.
profile.headline: Headline
profile.experienceHint: For example, eight years building backends.
profile.portfolioEmpty: Links to work you have done.
profile.whoSeesDetailsHint: Your headline, location, experience, about, portfolio and companies.
profile.contactHint: Separate from the rest, and hidden until you choose otherwise. Being findable is not the same as being reachable.
profile.whoSeesContactHint: Even set to anyone, nobody sees them unless they can see your profile.
profile.deleted: Your profile is deleted. Your account and messages are as they were.
profile.noneYetHint: A profile lets clients and other developers find you. It is entirely optional: without one, everything else works as it does now, and nobody can find you here.
profile.seeAsOthers: See it as a member would
profile.deleteDetail: It leaves the directory at once. Your account, messages and sessions are not affected.
profile.notFoundHint: Either there is no such person, they have no profile, or it is not visible to you.
profile.thisIsYou: This is your profile, as a member sees it.

company.createHint: You become its first administrator. Nobody else is listed until they accept.
company.noneYet: You are not part of any company here.
company.askedYou: Asked you to be listed on {date}
company.acceptMeans: Accepting shows your name on the company's page to everyone who can see it, and the company on your profile.
company.slugRule: Lower-case letters, digits and hyphens, up to 40.
company.name: Name
company.slugHint: Part of the page's link. It cannot be changed later.
company.notFound: No such company, or it is not visible to you.
company.inviteHint: They are listed only once they accept, from their own profile page.
company.invited: Asked {name}. They will be listed once they accept.
company.deleteDetail: Its page goes, and nobody is listed by it any longer. People's own profiles are not affected.
company.removeDetail: They stop being listed at once, on the company's page and on their profile.
